1.web: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
1.asv: I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

2.web: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
2.asv: O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

3.web: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
3.asv: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

4.web: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
4.asv: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial name.

5.web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
5.asv: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy cometh in the morning.

6.web: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
6.asv: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

7.web: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
7.asv: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

8.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. To Yahweh I made supplication:
8.asv: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:

9.web: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
9.asv: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

10.web: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
10.asv: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.

11.web: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
11.asv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

12.web: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
12.asv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Jehovah my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
